44852-yorkshire-battles.title: Yorkshire Battles.
44852-yorkshire-battles.creator: Edward Lamplough.
44852-yorkshire-battles.description: A book by Edward Lamplough.. pon the reign of weak and incapable princes are illustrated by the fields of Boroughbridge, Byland Abbey, and Myton-upon-Swale, and, in the first days of our greatest national struggle, the true men of Yorkshire freely shed their blood at Tadcaster, Bradford, Leeds, Wakefield, Adwalton Moor and Hull, keeping open the pathway by which Fairfax passed from Selby to Marston Moor.

63243-hope-farm-notes.title: Hope Farm Notes
63243-hope-farm-notes.creator: Herbert W. Collingwood
63243-hope-farm-notes.description: A book by Herbert W. Collingwood. As a boy on a little Yankee farm I had a “stent” set out for me every day. During the Winter it was sawing and splitting wood. Our barn stood so that somehow on a Winter’s day one side of it faced the road, and it always seemed to be warm and sunny. The other was turned so it was always cold and frosty, with little if any sun.

arxiv-2012-06320.title: Self-Growing Spatial Graph Network for Context-Aware Pedestrian Trajectory Prediction
arxiv-2012-06320.creator: Sirin Haddad, Siew-Kei Lam
arxiv-2012-06320.description: Abstract Pedestrian trajectory prediction is an active research area with recent works undertaken to embed accurate models of pedestrians social interactions and their contextual compliance into dynamic spatial graphs. However, existing works rely on spatial assumptions about the scene and dynamics, which entails a significant challenge to adapt the graph structure in unknown environments for an online system.

arxiv-2104-04645.title: Experimental Demonstration of RAN Functional Split over virtual PON Transport Network
arxiv-2104-04645.creator: Line Larsen 1 , Frank Slyne 2 , Ghizlane Mountaser 3 , Marco Ruffini 2 , Toktam Mahmoodi 3
arxiv-2104-04645.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Line Larsen 1 , Frank Slyne 2 , Ghizlane Mountaser 3 , Marco Ruffini 2 , Toktam Mahmoodi 3. Cloud-Radio Access Networks (Cloud-RANs) are separating the mobile network’s base station functions into three units, the connection between the two of them is referred to as the fronthaul network. This work demonstrates the transmission of user data transport blocks between the distributed Medium Access Control (MAC) layer and local Physical (PHY) layer in the radio unit over a Passive Optical Network (PON).

arxiv-2205-10949.title: Evaluating deep tracking models for player tracking in broadcast ice hockey video
arxiv-2205-10949.creator: Kanav Vats, Mehrnaz Fani, David A. Clausi, John S. Zelek
arxiv-2205-10949.description: Abstract Tracking and identifying players is an important problem in computer vision based ice hockey analytics. Player tracking is a challenging problem since the motion of players in hockey is fast-paced and non-linear. There is also significant player-player and player-board occlusion, camera panning and zooming in hockey broadcast video.

arxiv-2212-04522.title: A tale of two (or more) 𝒉 h ’s
arxiv-2212-04522.creator: Licia Verde
arxiv-2212-04522.description: Abstract We use the large-scale structure galaxy data (LSS) from the BOSS and eBOSS surveys, in combination with abundances information from Big Bang Nucleosynthesis (BBN), to measure two values of the Hubble expansion rate, H 0 = 100 ​ h ​ [ km ​ s − 1 ​ Mpc − 1 ] H_{0}=100h\,[{\rm km}\,{\rm s}^{-1}\,{\rm Mpc}^{-1}] , each of them

arxiv-2305-09630.title: Primordial black holes and inflation from double-well potentials
arxiv-2305-09630.creator: and Hardi Veermäe
arxiv-2305-09630.description: Abstract We investigate the formation of large peaks in the inflationary curvature power spectrum from double-well potentials. In such scenarios, the initial CMB spectrum is created at large field values. Subsequently, the inflaton will cross one of the minima and will decelerate rapidly as it reaches the local maximum at the origin, either falling back or crossing it.

arxiv-2306-03176.title: Calculations of the binding-energy differences for highly-charged Ho and Dy ions
arxiv-2306-03176.creator: I. M. Savelyev, M. Y. Kaygorodov, Y. S. Kozhedub, I. I. Tupitsyn, V. M. Shabaev
arxiv-2306-03176.description: Abstract The binding-energy differences for Ho q + 163 {}^{163}\mathrm{Ho}^{q+} and Dy q + 163 {}^{163}\mathrm{Dy}^{q+} ions with ionization degrees q = 38 q=38 , 39 39 , and 40 40 are calculated. The calculations are performed using the large-scale relativistic configuration-interaction and relativistic coupled-clusters methods. The contributions from quantum-electrodynamics, nuclear-recoil, and frequency-dependent Breit-interaction effects are taken into account.

arxiv-2401-10118.title: Techniques for Authenticating Quantile Digests
arxiv-2401-10118.creator: Alessandro Scala
arxiv-2401-10118.description: Abstract We investigate two possible techniques to authenticate the q-digest data structure, along with a worst-case study of the computational complexity both in time and space of the proposed solutions, and considerations on the feasibility of the presented approaches in real-world scenarios.

arxiv-2407-15256.title: Weak-instrument-robust subvector inference in instrumental variables regression: A subvector Lagrange multiplier test and properties of subvector Anderson-Rubin confidence sets
arxiv-2407-15256.creator: Malte Londschien, Peter Bühlmann
arxiv-2407-15256.description: Abstract We propose a weak-instrument-robust subvector Lagrange multiplier test for instrumental variables regression. We show that it is asymptotically size-correct under a technical condition or as the number of instruments grows to infinity. This is the first weak-instrument-robust subvector test for instrumental variables regression to recover the degrees of freedom of the commonly used non-weak-instrument-robust Wald test.

arxiv-2411-10580.title: Gradient-Based Stochastic Extremum-Seeking Control for Multivariable Systems with Distinct Input Delays
arxiv-2411-10580.creator: Paulo Cesar Souza Silva, Paulo César Pellanda, and Tiago Roux Oliveira
arxiv-2411-10580.description: Abstract This paper deals with the gradient extremum seeking control for static scalar maps with actuators governed by distributed diffusion partial differential equations (PDEs). To achieve the real-time optimization objective, we design a compensation controller for the distributed diffusion PDE via backstepping transformation in infinite dimensions.

arxiv-2412-10860.title: Classification of Financial Data Using Quantum Support Vector Machine
arxiv-2412-10860.creator: Seemanta Bhattacharjee, MD. Muhtasim Fuad, A.K.M. Fakhrul Hossain
arxiv-2412-10860.description: Abstract Quantum Support Vector Machine is a kernel-based approach to classification problems. We study the applicability of quantum kernels to financial data, specifically our self-curated Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSEx) Broad Index dataset. To the best of our knowledge, this is the very first systematic research work on this dataset on the application of quantum kernel.

arxiv-2503-02161.title: LLM-TabFlow: Synthetic Tabular Data Generation with Inter-column Logical Relationship Preservation
arxiv-2503-02161.creator: Yunbo Long, Liming Xu, Alexandra Brintrup
arxiv-2503-02161.description: Abstract Synthetic tabular data have widespread applications in industrial domains such as healthcare, finance, and supply chains, owing to their potential to protect privacy and mitigate data scarcity. However, generating realistic synthetic tabular data while preserving inter-column logical relationships remains a significant challenge for the existing generative models.

arxiv-2505-17510.title: Large Language Models Do Multi-Label Classification Differently
arxiv-2505-17510.creator: Marcus Ma, Georgios Chochlakis, Niyantha Maruthu Pandiyan
arxiv-2505-17510.description: Abstract Multi-label classification is prevalent in real-world settings, but the behavior of Large Language Models (LLMs) in this setting is understudied. We investigate how autoregressive LLMs perform multi-label classification, with a focus on subjective tasks, by analyzing the output distributions of the models in each generation step.

arxiv-2507-08480.title: Improving Korean-English Cross-Lingual Retrieval: A Data-Centric Study of Language Composition and Model Merging
arxiv-2507-08480.creator: Youngjoon Jang, Junyoung Son, Taemin Lee, Seongtae Hong, Heuiseok LimKorea University {dew1701, s0ny, taeminlee, ghdchlwls123, limhseok}@korea.ac.kr
arxiv-2507-08480.description: Abstract With the increasing utilization of multilingual text information, Cross-Lingual Information Retrieval (CLIR) has become a crucial research area. However, the impact of training data composition on both CLIR and Mono-Lingual Information Retrieval (IR) performance remains under-explored. To systematically investigate this data-centric aspect, we construct linguistically parallel Korean-English datasets and train retrieval models with various language combinations.

arxiv-2507-19208.title: Comparison of Knowledge Distillation Methods for Low-complexity Multi-microphone Speech Enhancement using the FT-JNF Architecture
arxiv-2507-19208.creator: Robert Metzger, Mattes Ohlenbusch, Christian Rollwage, Simon Doclo
arxiv-2507-19208.description: Abstract Multi-microphone speech enhancement using deep neural networks (DNNs) has significantly progressed in recent years. However, many proposed DNN-based speech enhancement algorithms cannot be implemented on devices with limited hardware resources. Only lowering the complexity of such systems by reducing the number of parameters often results in worse performance.

arxiv-2508-06896.title: Properties of cluster red-sequence spiral galaxies Journal: New Astronomy
arxiv-2508-06896.creator: Wayne A. Barkhouse, Lane M. Kashur, Moreom Akter, Sandanuwan P. Kalawila, Gihan L. Gamage, Omar López-Cruz
arxiv-2508-06896.description: Abstract We identify a sample of 324 red and 273 blue face-on spiral galaxies selected from 115 low-redshift ( 0.014 < z < 0.18 0.014<z<0.18 ) galaxy clusters imaged with CFHT+MegaCam in u u - and r r -band, KPNO 0.

arxiv-2601-02573.title: LendNova: Towards Automated Credit Risk Assessment with Language Models
arxiv-2601-02573.creator: Kiarash Shamsi, Danijel Novokmet, Joshua Peters, Mao Lin Liu, Paul K Edwards, Vahab Khoshdel
arxiv-2601-02573.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Kiarash Shamsi, Danijel Novokmet, Joshua Peters, Mao Lin Liu, Paul K Edwards, Vahab Khoshdel. Credit risk assessment is essential in the financial sector, but has traditionally depended on costly feature-based models that often fail to utilize all available information in raw credit records. This paper introduces LendNova, the first practical automated end-to-end pipeline for credit risk assessment, designed to utilize all available information in raw credit records by leveraging advanced NLP techniques and language models.

arxiv-2602-06202.title: Characterizing Quantum Error Correction Performance of Radiation-induced Errors
arxiv-2602-06202.creator: P. G. Baity, A. K. Nayak, L. R. Varshney, N. Jeon, B.-J. Yoon, P. J. Love, A. Hoisie
arxiv-2602-06202.description: Abstract Radiation impacts are a current challenge with computing on superconducting-based quantum devices because they can lead to widespread correlated errors across the device. Such errors can be problematic for quantum error correction (QEC) codes, which are generally designed to correct independent errors.

pmc-10590646.title: Severe Burns of the Genital Area After Laser Hair Removal: A Case Report
pmc-10590646.creator: Ilina Braynova, Pavel Timonov, Antoaneta Fasova, Alexandar Alexandrov
pmc-10590646.description: Burn injuries are among the most commonly observed complications of laser hair removal. Here, we present a case, in which severe massive burns were caused in the genital and perineal areas during such a procedure. The consequent scar formation led not only to negative aesthetic effects but also affected the physical and psychological health of the patient.

pmc-10630591.title: Unusual presentation of tractional retinal detachment in beta thalassemia minor
pmc-10630591.creator: Mohammed Sultan Alshehri, Faisal Saeed Alqahtani
pmc-10630591.description: PurposeTo report a case of proliferative retinopathy with tractional retinal detachment associated with beta thalassemia minor in a 27-year-old female.ObservationsA young lady having beta thalassemia minor presented with decreased vision in both eyes, the effect being more severe in her right eye. The patient's other systemic history, including ophthalmic history, was unremarkable.

pmc-10638102.title: Malarial Antibodies and Endemicity: Does It Affect SARS-CoV-2 Severity and Outcomes?
pmc-10638102.creator: Prayas Sethi, Tamoghna Ghosh, Souradeep Chowdhury, Raunak Bir, Nishant Verma, Shivam Pandey, Arulselvi Subramanian, Ved Meena, Neeraj Nischal, Sulagna Bhattacharjee, Ajisha Aravindan, Rahul K Anand, Devalina Goswami, Richa Aggarwal, Naveet Wig
pmc-10638102.description: BackgroundIndia has a disproportionately lower rate of coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) severe disease and lower death rates with respect to other parts of the world. It has been proposed that malaria-endemic countries such as India are relatively protected against severe COVID-19 disease and deaths.

pmc-12583406.title: Mikronährstoffe bei Säuglingen, Kindern und Jugendlichen – Bedeutung und Versorgungssituation
pmc-12583406.creator: Anna-Kristin Brettschneider, Andrea Schlune, Clarissa Spiegler, Leonie Burgard, Regina Ensenauer
pmc-12583406.description: Eine optimale Versorgung mit Mikronährstoffen ist für Säuglinge, Kinder und Jugendliche von großer Bedeutung und wird durch eine altersentsprechende, ausgewogene und abwechslungsreiche Ernährung gewährleistet. Daten zur Nährstoffversorgung dieser Altersgruppen liefern bundesweite Verzehrserhebungen wie die „Kinder-Ernährungsstudie zur Erfassung des Lebensmittelverzehrs“ (KiESEL-Studie) und die „Ernährungsstudie als KiGGS-Modul“ (EsKiMo II).

pmc-12603151.title: Targeting GPR3 as a novel approach for nicotine cessation therapeutic development
pmc-12603151.creator: Allison S. Mogul, Kendyl N. Laumann, Malia Bautista, JP Fowler, Bruce E. Blough, Elaine A. Gay, Christie D. Fowler
pmc-12603151.description: Tobacco use remains the leading cause of preventable death worldwide. Unfortunately, currently available cessation aids have limited long-term efficacy. GPR3 is a Gαs coupled receptor expressed in discrete brain regions, with notably high expression in cholinergic neurons of the medial habenula. Here, we investigated whether modulation of GPR3 could be a viable target for therapeutic development to promote nicotine cessation.

pmc-12816119.title: Evaluation of myocardial fibrosis and cardiac function in fibrotic lung diseases: a prospective study
pmc-12816119.creator: Süleyman Ekiz, Kaan Esen, Sibel Naycı, Yüksel Balcı, Hasan Hüsnü Yüksek
pmc-12816119.description: This research sought to elucidate the possible fibrotic effects of lung diseases accompanied by fibrosis on the heart with mapping methods. In this prospective study, 35 patients with fibrotic lung disease and 17 healthy volunteer participants with no known disease were enrolled.

pmc-13583476.title: Super-selective distal splenic artery embolization-assisted laparoscopic partial splenectomy for a benign splenic cyst: a case report
pmc-13583476.creator: Tze Hee (Zac) Tay, Doruk Seyfi, Muddassir Rashid, Ramesh Damodaran Prabha
pmc-13583476.description: Splenic cysts are uncommon, and contemporary management increasingly favors minimally invasive, spleen-preserving approaches. Partial splenectomy provides definitive treatment but may be limited by intraoperative bleeding risk. Selective distal splenic artery embolization (SAE) can reduce arterial inflow, create a parenchymal demarcation plane, and facilitate safer resection.
